tests.invariant: assigned published service is offered at checkout
tests.given: admin assigns a published Shipping method live now for the offer's seller/store/destination
tests.expected: Checkout eligibility read for a cart with that offer returns exactly that method

tests.given: offer has no shipping service assigned
tests.expected: checkout excludes it; typed ineligible reason; no default method

tests.given: offer assigned a method that is not currently published/valid
tests.expected: method not offered; group may become ineligible

tests.given: offer assigned a method owned by a different seller (Marketplace)
seller has two distinct methods of the same type both valid
tests.expected: both appear (no dedupe by type alone)

tests.given: two sellers each with one valid method in one cart
tests.expected: each group shows only its own seller's method

tests.invariant: multi-offer group with no common method
tests.given: group has offers whose assigned methods have no common method
tests.expected: group ineligible (fail-closed) — OR per decided DG-01 policy

tests.given: method valid for destination A, not B
tests.expected: offered for A, excluded for B

tests.given: method valid only within a window/cutoff

tests.expected: no invented method; no unauthorized Pricing/Inventory/Shipping writes
